name: Stepper
intent: A row of numbered steps that shows where a person is in a flow of a few steps: done, current and still to come.
usage: Use Stepper above a flow that is split into a few steps, like a setup wizard or an import: Setup, Map Columns, Billing IDs. It is one component: pass steps as labels and current as the step number, starting at 1. Steps before current are done (green with a check), current is brand with its number, later steps are gray. A current past the last step shows every step done. onStepClick makes done steps buttons, to go back and change them. fill spreads the steps across the full width. The Stepper only shows progress; the page shows the step's content and its Back and Next buttons. See contracts/stepper.json for the full contract.

steps.note: One short label per step, in order. Two to seven steps.

current.note: The step the person is on, starting at 1. Past the last step means all done.

size.note: md has a 32 circle; sm has a 24 circle and smaller text, for Drawers and Modals.

fill.note: Steps share the full width and the lines grow. Off: 100-wide steps, centered.

label.note: Name of the list for screen readers, like Import progress.

onStepClick.note: Makes done steps buttons that go back to that step. The current and later steps are never clickable.

useWhen: A flow of two to seven steps done in order, like a setup wizard or an import.
Showing which steps are done and which are left.
doNot: Do not use it for page sections the person can visit in any order. Use Tabs.
Do not use it for a single amount done. Use Progress.
Do not put the Back and Next buttons inside it; they belong to the page.
Do not use long labels; keep each to one or two words.
a11y: An ordered list with a label, so the number of steps is read.
The current step has aria-current step; each step says completed, current step or not started.
The circles are hidden from screen readers; the label and state are read.
Done steps are real buttons when onStepClick is set, reachable with Tab.

examples.title: Progress
examples.usage: Done steps are green with a check, the current step is brand, later steps are gray.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: md for pages; sm for Drawers and Modals.
